PLpgSQL_expr.query:
SELECT 1
      FROM public.command_principal
     WHERE organization_id=org
       AND principal_id=actor
     FOR UPDATE

SELECT unnest(ARRAY[
            'transaction-identity/subject/1:' ||
                org || ':' ||
                conn || ':' ||
                pg_catalog.octet_length(ref) || ':' ||
                ref,
            'transaction-identity/target/1:' ||
                org || ':' ||
                target
        ])
        ORDER BY 1
